legal_privacy_meta_description: Read the privacy policy for {siteName}, including media use, account information and support.
legal_privacy_intro: This policy explains how {siteName} handles account information and media used to create dance videos.
legal_privacy_collect_body: We process your account email, uploaded portraits and reference videos, generation results, credit balance, payment status and limited technical information used to operate the service and prevent abuse. Card details are processed by the payment provider, not stored by this site.
legal_privacy_processors_body: Cloudflare provides hosting and storage. When live generation is enabled, media and instructions are sent to Yir and its selected model provider. Stripe processes payments. Optional Google sign-in shares account identity. We do not sell your uploaded media.
legal_privacy_retention_body: Media and job records remain in service storage until removed by the operator or an account deletion request, except records needed for legal, fraud or billing obligations. This version has no automatic media-expiry guarantee. Contact support to request media or account deletion.
legal_privacy_cookies_body: Essential cookies keep you signed in, protect guest usage limits and remember language and attribution choices. Generator drafts may be stored in your browser session. Analytics, if configured, are described here before activation.
legal_privacy_choices_body: Use only photos and clips you have permission to process. This service is for adults aged 18 and over. Contact support to request access, correction or deletion of your information.
legal_terms_meta_description: Read the terms policy for {siteName}, including media use, account information and support.
legal_terms_intro: These terms govern use of {siteName} and its AI-assisted dance-video tools.
legal_terms_service_body: The service combines your portraits with a motion reference to request an AI video. Results can vary and may contain artifacts or fail to preserve likeness, motion, duration or audio. No result, completion time or social-media performance is guaranteed.
legal_terms_content_body: You retain your rights to your uploads. You grant only the processing permission needed to deliver the service. Upload only adult subjects with permission and media you own or are licensed to use. Do not create harassment, sexual content, impersonation or misleading evidence. Clearly identify realistic synthetic videos as AI-generated when sharing.
legal_terms_credits_body: A generation costs the credits displayed before submission. Packs are one-time purchases with no automatic subscription and no stated credit expiry. Prices are in USD unless displayed otherwise. Failed or canceled jobs return credits under the shared job settlement rules. See /refunds for purchase-refund requests.
legal_terms_warranty_body: The service is provided as available, without a guarantee of fitness or uninterrupted operation. Statutory consumer rights are unaffected. Material changes will be reflected in the updated policy date. Contact support before relying on a result for commercial or sensitive use.
legal_refunds_meta_description: Read the refunds policy for {siteName}, including media use, account information and support.
legal_refunds_intro: This policy covers generation credits and purchase-refund requests for {siteName}.
legal_refunds_failed_body: A job that reaches a failed or canceled final state returns its charged credits automatically. A delayed job may still be running; check its status before starting another. Contact support if a terminal failure has not returned credits.
legal_refunds_unused_body: Request a refund for a completely unused credit pack within 14 days of purchase. Include the purchase identifier and account email. Partially used packs and completed generations are reviewed individually; applicable consumer rights continue to apply.
legal_refunds_ask_body: Contact the support address below with your account email, order or job identifier and a short description. Do not send payment-card numbers. Refunds are issued to the original payment method when approved; provider processing times vary.
legal_dmca_meta_description: Read the dmca policy for {siteName}, including media use, account information and support.
legal_dmca_intro: Use this page to report alleged copyright infringement involving {siteName}.
legal_dmca_notice_body: Send support your contact details, a description of the copyrighted work, the exact location of the allegedly infringing material, a good-faith statement that its use is not authorized, a statement of accuracy and authority under penalty of perjury, and your physical or electronic signature.
legal_dmca_counter_body: If material was removed by mistake, contact support with identification of the material, your contact information, your good-faith statement under penalty of perjury and the statements and consent required by applicable law. Counter-notices may be forwarded to the original claimant.
legal_dmca_repeat_body: We may restrict or terminate accounts that repeatedly infringe intellectual-property rights. This site is independent and is not affiliated with TikTok, CapCut, the trend creators or the owners of any music or television material.
